transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the board has authorized us to consider repurchasing up to 5,000,000 common shares this quarter. With our stock trading near $8.25 and sufficient cash on hand, I'd like to move through our standard capital-return review process. Before I finalize any authorization, I need input from each of your areas: treasury on cash flow and funding implications, legal and compliance on regulatory considerations, and investor relations on how the market might interpret different offer sizes and execution methods. The board has left the final offer size, price, and execution method to my discretion, so your input will be critical to getting this right. What are each of you seeing from your perspectives?
